title: MLEADERSTYLE packed DXF color transport
mode: P2 local parser, writer and source-bound adapter slice
scope: Parse and write MLEADERSTYLE groups 91, 93 and 94 as legacy scalar or packed C0-C3 DXF colors.
Carry represented color method, scalar index and RGB values through source-bound replay, ASCII/Binary conversion, scalar and RGB edits, and typed serialization.
Refuse unrepresented color names, book names, flags, reserved metadata indices and unknown packed methods rather than dropping them.

implementation.summary: Added a shared internal decoder/encoder for scalar and packed MLEADERSTYLE colors. C0/C1 decode by method and ignore lower payload bits; C2 uses 24-bit RGB; C3 uses the low-byte ACI value, including ACI zero. The source adapter detects typed color edits, preserves untouched raw groups, canonicalizes edited packed colors, and fails closed when color metadata is not represented by the DXF projection.
behaviorChanges: Groups 91/93/94 now parse C0 BYLAYER, C1 BYBLOCK, C2 RGB and C3 ACI values instead of treating every signed packed value as an invalid scalar.
The low-level writer emits canonical packed values from typed color state and retains the legacy scalar forms.
The adapter supports untouched ASCII/Binary replay and cross-format conversion, one-field scalar and RGB edits, typed serialization, destination-preserving refusal and same-adapter retry.
Generated controls cover ignored C0/C1 payloads, ignored upper C3 payload bytes, C3 ACI zero, and canonical typed output.

results.focusedCTest: PASS 1/1 in 2.82 seconds; selector runs ASCII and Binary source routes.
results.profile: PASS for unchanged same-format output, ASCII/Binary conversion, scalar and RGB edits, typed serializer output, exact packed group values, output readback, refusal preserving an existing destination and corrected retry.

limitations: The profile covers MLEADERSTYLE packed DXF colors only; it does not establish native MLEADER annotation or rendering semantics.
Unknown packed methods and color name/book/flags/reserved-index metadata remain refused.
The peer drawing is only a raw token witness and is not a successful complete semantic document; generated controls establish local parser/writer behavior, not native application acceptance.
No LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD, platform, ABI, whole-document, full-suite or support-claim gate is promoted.
